Dialogs.Dialog: You're into rock and punk and stuff, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
I've got an issue with you lumping rock and punk together like that, but... what about it？
You don't play in a band or anything yourself, huh.
I see. Just not interested in playing instruments？
I might've mentioned this before, but... I bought a guitar a while back and gave up pretty much right away.
If I had a good reason to start again, I'd like to give it another try, though...
Huh, is that how it is.
Sigh... Nice and peaceful again today...
Peaceful is great and all, but don't slack off. Lots of people using the library today.
Yeah, yeah. I'll get to it.
Every bit of work you don't do just makes more trouble for me...
That goes for you too... All you've been doing is chatting with Kobayakawa...
Ugh, fine, I get it. I'm going.
Look, if you have something to say, why don't you just say it？
...S-Something to say!? ...What's that supposed to mean... I-I don't... How detestable...
Um... well... there's someone waiting, so... everyone should get back to work... I'm sorry...
Excuse me! Can I get some help at the desk？
See...? It's all your fault... Detestable...
(Getting pretty crowded in here... A packed library？ I can't tell if this school is studious or what...)
Oh, hey there! So, how've things been with Rinko lately？
Well, you know... Pretty good, right？
Hey, don't go saying anything unnecessary, okay？
Unnecessary？ Like... all the couple stuff we do？
Huh, looks like you two are getting along great.
Ah, um... What do I do... Um...
Oh, there you are, Hara! Heard you were in the library, so we came looking for you♪
Hey, look at that girl... Doesn't she just scream 'library committee'？
Like, look—thick glasses, long skirt, braided hair, the whole deal, right？
I-I'm sorry... U-Um, if you make too much noise...
Whoa, she's huge. Kinda intimidating, honestly...
I-I'm sorry... Um, er... I'm really sorry...
Hey... come on, let's just go already, okay？
Hey. Could you not make a racket in the library？
Wait, Hara, are you friends with... Kobayakawa？
Um, that's not what I meant. ...Rinko's fine, it's just... her friends lately are kind of gloomy, I guess...
Hey, what's going on over here! Quiet in the library!
You guys shouldn't join in and make a racket either.
Ugh, that makes me so mad...
You mean... that thing in the library the other day？
That friend of yours, ▲小早川＊▲... Hara-chan, was it？
I didn't think she was so cold. Laughing along with those girls like that!
...Getting mocked like that by a friend... really stings.
I had no idea Hara-chan felt that way...
She was probably just trying to save face in front of her friends. You know？
(I hope this doesn't turn into a fight or anything...)
(All right, time for library duty again today!)
(Everyone seems so down... Are they still bothered by what happened before...？)
Our homeroom teacher is the worst. Staying after to chat in class is normal, right？
Totally! I don't get why we had to get kicked out.
Ahahaha! That is so not you!
U-Um. I-I'm sorry... Could you keep it down a little...
Excuse me. Everyone uses the library, so could you please keep it down？
If everyone uses it, then we can be here too, right？
Yeah, we have a right to!
That's why I'm telling you to be quiet! Your loud chatting is bothering people trying to read! Don't you get that？
Um... Hey, no point staying here forever anyway. Wanna go do karaoke or something？
Phew, at least things didn't get out of hand today.
Hey, doesn't that frustrate you two？ Letting them walk all over us like that.
Not really... I just try not to let it bother me...
Ugh, seriously! Don't you guys want to get back at them？ Where's your rock 'n' roll soul!？
People just assume the library committee is gloomy and weak! We should show them something that proves them totally wrong!
Is that what a rock 'n' roll soul is？ Wait, you mean playing music？
That's not what I mean... Rock is a state of mind!
...Wait, hmm... Actually, music might not be a bad idea... Music... rock... Maybe a band？
Yeah... a band! That could work!
Hold on, ▲小早川＊▲. What is it, Nagakura？
I-I'm sorry... It's not rock, but... I played drums in the brass band back in middle school...
Seriously？ I wouldn't have guessed by looking at you... Oh, like folk-pop or something？
What does that have to do with anything？ Way to be rude.
Now, now! Still, you all have experience playing instruments. That's awesome!
I'm sure she can, seeing how big she's talking.
We'll make it work! Alright... then it's settled!
Hey... Were you serious about starting a band？
Obviously. We're gonna totally shock Hara-chan and her friends!
Just to shock them...？ Is that even gonna be fun？
You think you can play punk just by having fun？
Oh, so it's punk... Wait, is punk not fun？
That's not it, but... Music takes spirit, you know？ Spirit.
I don't really get it, but...
You take that 'Ugh, I'm so ticked off!' feeling and slam it right into the music.
(Come to think of it, I wonder what's happening with that band ▲小早川＊▲ mentioned before...)
All right! We're having a band meeting, so gather round, everyone!
You're part of this too, so sit down and join us.
Um... What kind of band are we talking about？
Because Rinko... I mean, I'm the one who brought it up...
Ack! I mean, no, look—I thought about it a lot, and... I figured it really has to be punk.
I've only ever played Sasada Masashige, though.
Oh, right. So by guitar, you meant that kind of...
What's that supposed to mean...？ Sasada Masashige is n-not gloomy!
U-Um... Is punk different from rock or metal？
Different？ It's totally different! Listen, the whole point of punk is—
Stop! You can skip the lecture.
I-I'm sorry... I shouldn't have asked...
Hey, assuming we're doing this "punk" thing... don't we have a lot to figure out first？
(...Are the two of them actually into this？)
What are we doing about vocals？ Are you going to sing, Kobayakawa？
Hmm... That wouldn't be bad, but... singing while playing is a bit much...
Besides, this is punk we're talking about, so we really need a guy on vocals.
Oh, so an all-girl band with just a guy on vocals!
Yeah, exactly. Plus, while we're at it, we might as well keep the lineup all library committee members.
It feels kinda literary, you know？ Intellectual, destructive punk—pretty cool, right？
...What do you even mean by destructive...？
I-I'm sorry... I don't really get it, though...
Never mind if you don't get it. Now, is there any guy on the library committee who looks like he's got free time？
A guy on the library committee with free time on his hands, huh...
A couple in a band together... How sickening...
I think it's a good idea... It's a lot less stressful than looking for a stranger. A guy I've never even talked to would be...
(A band with this lineup... Is this really gonna work？)
What？ Ready to give a speech on your resolve？
No. Are you really sure about ●？
Hey. Don't complain after it's already been decided.
You're a punk now too, so get it together.
A punk, huh... Even so, though？
Why're you getting so involved with those two？ It's kinda unusual for you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well, neither of them ever speaks their mind. If I stay quiet, I'll never know what they're thinking.
Watching them kinda reminds me of myself, I guess...
All right, let's start the band meeting.
Well that's sudden! ...Not that I'm busy, though.
What's your deal...？ Why are you calling the shots...？
What, got a problem with that？ It was my idea.
I mean, you can take charge if you want？
I-I'm sorry... Um, please don't get mad, you two...
First, let's assign parts. Who plays which instrument.
I told you already... I used to play guitar...
So what？ You only play acoustic anyway. It's pretty much the same thing.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. That's a little unfair to Sasaki...
See？ She says she'll do it.
And our band's goal is: "Play live at the London Million Club!"
What the heck... Take this seriously...
I know, I know. Well, wanna play it safe and do a show at a local joint？
A music club. Haven't you at least been to one？
And Sasaki... I take it you haven't either.
Right. Put you down for a no.
Now, now! Still, playing at a club... isn't that setting the bar kind of high？ People actually pay to come watch, right？
No way! I could never do that... Never in a million years...
Of course it's out of the question!
Y-You think so？ I wanted to give it a shot, though... Yeah, maybe that's a bit much.
Oh... Come to think of it, my friend in the Light Music Club mentioned something...
Our Light Music Club puts on regular concerts in the auditorium... and she said every now and then, they let independent bands from outside the club perform too...
Huh. Now that you mention it, I think I have seen them doing that.
If it's just something like that...
Hmm, a school music club event, huh...
Why do you sound so disappointed？
Come on, it's just so small-time...
You and the others have never been in a band before, ●, so isn't that just about right？
Playing at school might actually work better for showing up those flashy girls... Yeah, I like it!
Then that's our goal! We're gonna play at the Light Music Club's live show!
What is with you？ Why are you suddenly so confident...？
(A Light Music Club event, huh... Sounds like fun!)
(Huh... Over there, isn't that ▲小早川＊▲ and...)
Hey, Rinko. You haven't really been hanging out with me lately, have you？
Mm... I just started something new, that's all.
Whoa, that's cool. Did you join the Light Music Club or something？
No, I'm doing it with the others on the library committee.
...Hey, Rinko. About the other day... You know, in the library.
...You know, I really don't think flashy girls like them are your type of crowd, Hara.
Hmm. They're actually really nice once you talk to them. Why don't you try making friends with them too, Rinko？
Forgot something？ Want to go back for it？
No, not that. I mean the band. Our band name!
A band name？ Oh, right... We have to come up with one of those.
Obviously. Every great band has a cool name.
I see. Should we all get together and decide on one？
Hmm, when too many people try to talk something like that over, it takes forever to settle on anything.
Maybe so, but shouldn't we at least ask everyone—
I already have a rough idea. It just hasn't quite clicked into place yet... Hehehe.
(She just wants to pick it herself...)
Hey, I came up with a few ideas.
Our band name. Look, I wrote them down. Which of these do you like best？
Out of these... I'd go with ▲バンド＊▲!
In the Rye, huh... Yeah, I knew it. Right？
The Dada？ Going with that one, huh... Well, works for me.
Towano Librarians？ That one was just filler, though... Well, whatever.
Rinko & The Stupid!？ ...You're okay with that？ Well... fine by me.
(Is it really okay for just her and ● to decide this on our own...？)
All right, sorry to keep you waiting. I have an important announcement to make.
What's this all of a sudden？
Our band name has been decided.
Hold on a second! Why are you just deciding that on your own？
Why do you get to decide...？ Nagakura-senpai, say something to her...
Me？ Um, well, I don't really mind... I-I'm sorry...
See, Nagakura-senpai's fine with it... And you agreed too, didn't you？
●？ I wouldn't really call that agreeing...
...Girls with boyfriends, I swear... A band with your lover？ Good for you... What even is this... Ugh, how infuriating...
Ugh... Oh, whatever, just hear me out.
Our band name is In the Rye!
Our band name is The Dada!
Our band name is The Towano Librarians!
Our band name is Rinko & The Stupid!
Hmph. Then it's my turn next, right？ Actually, I thought of one too—
That name... I kind of like it...
...What is with you guys... How infuriating...
What should we do about instruments and stuff？ ● is fine, but... what about everyone else？
I-I'm sorry... I don't own a drum set... I wonder if the school would let us use theirs...
I don't have a bass either, you know.
Huh!? Don't just say that like it's nothing!
It'll be fine, they make cheap ones too. Not fussing over gear is what punk's all about.
I keep telling you, I don't know anything about punk...
A bass... I think my brother had a beat-up old one somewhere... mutter, mutter...
Oh, about that—come with me for a bit.
Right, now that I think about it, you did say you had a guitar.
Yeah. Well, I left it sitting around for a long time, so I figured it could use a tune-up.
All right. Then let ● take a look at it first!
Don't get all worked up. Do you even know anything about guitars？
Let's see... The electronics look fine. The pots are a little scratchy, but that's an easy fix.
The frets have barely any wear. The neck has a slight forward bow, though... I'll adjust the truss rod for you.
Forward... Oh, yeah, really？ Just what I thought!
All right, I'll hold on to it for you then. It'll be ready on—
Man, makes me feel like I'm really in a band! Even if I barely understood a word he said!
We haven't even done anything yet... Hehe, I'm looking forward to it, though.
(She really looks like she's having fun... ● is gonna give it everything too!)
(All right, another day of band life!)
Hey, come to think of it.
How does being in a band actually work？ Like, where do we practice and stuff？
Hehe, I've already got that covered.
Oh, Sensei. How did it go？
Yeah, I got the okay. The light music club doesn't use it every day, so you're free to use it on their off days.
Just make sure you keep up with your committee work, too.
Good grief. Well, if this gets her motivated...
I had Sensei ask if our band could borrow the music room the light music club uses for practice.
When did you set that up...？
Hehe, you've gotta move fast with stuff like this.
(Alright, time to be a band guy again today!)
We won't get anywhere just standing around holding our instruments...
Um... What are we doing for a song...？
A song？ Oh, right, a song... Um, first off, how about we all just warm up and play whatever？ Okay, go!
Like you didn't just forget... Hehe...
W-we're having a song meeting right after! ...That was the plan all along.
I knew it'd be like this... A couple's band, seriously... *Sigh*...
I-is this going to be okay...？
*Sigh* I can't believe you forgot something that basic...
I didn't forget! I just wanted us all to make some noise first and get a feel for it!
Quit flirting... You make me sick...
Really？ I'm kind of... jealous, aren't you？
Ahem! Anyway, if we're gonna do this, we should do an original song.
Now you're asking for something crazy again...
Not a cover？ Who's supposed to write it, then...？
Nagakura-senpai, you were in the brass band, right？ Can't you write songs or something？
M-me!? I'm sorry... I don't know the first thing about that... I'm sorry...
It's fine, really. Then what about you...？
Yeah, no way. What about you, Sasaki-san？
I've never written music before either...
What's that reaction for...？ I mean, I was curious about writing a little instead of just playing guitar, sure...
Seriously！？ You can totally pull it off！
You'll be fine！ You get good grades, Sasaki, and study hard. If you study songwriting too, it'll be easy, won't it？
I'll lend you all the classic punk albums for reference！ Come on, please！
'Please'...？ You're the one who wants to do it, right？ Why don't you write it...？
...That's what I thought, so I gave it a little try... and it went terribly...
So I was hoping maybe you could teach me how to write songs later...
...Oh, so that's your angle... ...Heh heh, fine...
But I'm not teaching you... We're going to play the song that I write...
Well, you were asking for a bit much there.
Ugh, fine, I get it！ But I'm definitely writing the lyrics！
(Huh... Over there, isn't that ▲小早川＊▲ and...)
I kind of avoided you after what happened. Sorry.
I thought about it right after, and I felt bad... It wasn't even your fault, Hara.
...Anyway, I'd hate for things to get weird between us over something like that.
Those girls are actually pretty nice once you get to know them, though...
Yeah, about that... I don't think I can.
I see... Okay, I get it. Anyway, we're good now.
(Seems like things are still a bit awkward between them...)
Hey, how are the lyrics going？ Coming along okay？
Oh yeah...？ Hey, let me see.
Why not？ It's fine, isn't it？ Come on, let's see！
No way！ It's not done yet... Besides, showing you one-on-one is embarrassing. I'd rather show everyone all at once.
(All right, time to be in a band again today！)
Well, I did try putting something together...
Please don't set the bar so high...
Well, that's all it is... What？ Got a complaint？ ...What is it... Curses...
Well, looks like my eye for talent was spot on. Nice job!
What's with the high-and-mighty attitude... D-Do you really think it's good？
You're amazing, Sasaki... I'm honestly kind of moved...
N-No way, you're exaggerating... Heh heh...
Oh, I'd love to read them.
Yeah... You really have a knack for this, Kobayakawa.
To be honest, I'd been sitting on some ideas like this for a while... Maybe that's why.
Um, what do you think of them, Sasaki？
I think they're good... I-It's not like I'm just returning the compliment, or doing some gross friendship thing!
...Ugh, I just went full tsundere without trying...
Still, you really are talented, Kobayakawa...
I think I'm really going to cry... *sniff*...
Yeah, we've got a great song and great lyrics... Now the band can really get going!
Yeah... Somehow even I'm starting to get choked up... Thanks, everyone.
...It's not like I'm doing this for you...
All right, let's practice hard from here on out!
We're a little late. I wonder if the other two are here yet.
Oh... It's the light music club!
Ooh, any cute guys in there？
Let's see... Wait, it's just girls... Hold on, aren't they...
What is this... a band？ Seriously!？
Are you gonna play rock and stuff？
No way! They're on the library committee, right？
What's their deal... Why did they come here... They're in the way...
U-Um, I'm sorry... We're in the middle of practice...
Oh, sooorry for getting in your way.
Come on, you two, stand tall! It's not like they were complaining about us.
...Why is she acting so bossy... How irritating...
(▲小早川＊▲ is starting to act like a real leader.)
(All right, time to be in the band again today!)
Come on, let's head to the music room.
Hey, why are you using the music room？ It's supposed to be our turn today.
How should I know？ Who even are you？
Ain't they the ones the advisor mentioned？ Somethin' about the library committee.
Oh yeah, he did say that. Man, don't get all cocky when you're just borrowing the place. We're using it today.
Or what, you wanna stick around and watch？
As if. You're just at a high school club level anyway.
Why you... Have you even heard us play？!
Whoa, whoa, sorry about that! Well... since we're here, maybe we will watch for a bit. Right？
So yeah! We won't get in the way, so let us watch for a bit!
Hey, quit grinning at them like that.
Come on, I don't like their attitude either, but watching another band play could be good reference for us.
That might be true... We're beginners, after all... and we never get to see an amateur band play live.
Well, of course we're no match for the regulars... How detestable...
(Can ● and the others really put on a show alongside these guys...？)
(All right, back to band duty today!)
All right, work's done. Shall we practice？
There's nothing we can do without a place to play... What are we supposed to do？
It looks like the Light Music Club is using the music room again today.
Hmm... Then how about we try using a studio off-campus？
Whoa... So this is a rehearsal studio!
Don't we seem... a little out of place？ ...I feel like everyone here is looking down on us... How detestable...
Don't go chickening out on me, Senpai!
You heard those Light Music Club guys play, right？ We've gotta practice more!
Y-You're right... Okay... I-I'll do my best...
Amazing... The sound resonates so differently in here.
Hehe... This might actually be fun...
We're really starting to feel like a band!
It feels great being able to play as loud as we want!
Somehow it makes me feel like I've gotten better...
For real. We should've come here sooner.
...It costs money, though... so coming here a lot might be tough...
Yeah, let's stick to the music room whenever it's free.
And it's all because of that detestable light music club...
Down with the light music club!
(...Wait, hasn't our goal kind of changed？)
(Huh... Over there, isn't that ▲小早川＊▲ and...)
Rinko. Are you still doing that band thing？
What do you mean, 'still'...? I'm not planning on quitting. At least not until the show.
Yeah. You know that event the light music club puts on？
Ah, I know it's a thing. Never been to one, though.
Right. I haven't either, actually. ...Will you come watch？
Of course, I'll totally be there. I'll even make a fan sign to wave for you.
What am I, a pop idol？
Hey. How's the guitar coming along？
Oh... Yeah, well, I'm working on it.
Give it a rest... Must be nice being the carefree lead singer.
Huh？ You think so...? Well, singing is actually pretty fun!
Oh, good for you. Wait... is it going to your head？
No way, it's not like that!
You're not thinking, 'Now I'm gonna be a total chick magnet,' are you？
I told you, I'm not... Wait, are lead singers really popular with girls？
Hehe. Well, I'll keep plugging away at the guitar...
I feel like we're starting to come together, more or less...
It's the guitar... It's not good enough at all.
U-um... But... if she keeps practicing like this...
Sasaki... Um, I really think Kobayakawa's been practicing a lot.
The fingers on her left hand are a mess... and she improves a bit more every practice...
And besides... she cares so much about this band...
Still... some people just aren't cut out for certain things...
The bass part in this song isn't that hard... That's the only reason I'm getting by...
...It's a problem if she walks out on us, so why don't you go bring her back...
Hmph. Getting her boyfriend to go comfort her like this... How irritating...
Hehe, there's nothing wrong with that.
(I can still hear you, you know...)
Yeah, sorry... I'll be right back.
I've been thinking things through, too. It'll probably be fine.
(I have a bad feeling about this...)
I just wasn't cut out for guitar. My hands are too small to hold down the chords.
With bass, it's just single notes, so it shouldn't be a problem, right？
After all the practice I've put in... You can't ask that now...
Sorry! I know I'm the one who asked to play guitar first, and I feel bad... Please.
...I've practiced hard, too, so I want this band to succeed...
If switching parts will make the band better...
Hmph. If we teach each other what we've practiced so far, it'll be a bit easier...
Hey, mind if I borrow your bass for a second？
Yeah, this feels right. Punk's all about the bass, after all.
Shinomun is super cool, too. Maybe I'll smash the bass just like on that album cover!
Also, I have one more favor to ask...
Would you mind if I used this bass？
(All right, another day in the band!)
That just now... might've been really good...
Hey, don't ruin the mood. All right, meeting time!
I can't believe I forgot something so important.
What's that about...？ You want us to wear outfits？
What do you mean, obviously...？ Obvious to who...？ I'm not wearing some outfit...
Outfits...？ Like what？ It's a school event, so nothing too flashy, right？
Fun or not, we don't need outfits...
Yep, outfits! The question is how we're gonna make them—
Hold on, ▲小早川＊▲. What is it, Nagakura？
S-sorry... The outfits... um, would you let me make them...？
S-sorry... Um, it's fine if you don't want me to... I just... really like coming up with things like that, and...
Kobayakawa-san is writing the lyrics... and Sasaki-san wrote the music... I'm the only one who hasn't done anything.
You don't need to worry about that... The one doing nothing here is that guy over there.
Still, if you're willing to do it, that'd be a huge help. Right？
I mean... I don't really mind...
Yeah... thank you. Of course, I'll take everyone's input too.
Heh, of course! I definitely want a say in the design... Oh, and I'll help make them too, okay？
(All right, back to the band life today!)
Okay, we're having a meeting. Gather round.
What ever happened with those stage outfits we talked about？
Oh, don't worry about that. Us girls have it covered.
No boys allowed on this one.
Relax. We're making one for you too. Right, Senpai？
So yeah, you'll have to wait till the show to see our outfits!
(I'm curious... though I guess it gives me more to look forward to.)
(All right, back to the band life today!)
Hey. Wanna hang out a bit before practice today？
(All right, better get ready to head out...)
Uh-oh, are we gonna make it in time...？
Maybe not... At this rate we'll be late.
Talk about bad luck. Delayed trains, roadwork... Total miscalculation...
...Why are you both showing up late together...？
You were probably out on a date anyway. Ugh, girls with boyfriends... Disgusting...
I already said I'm sorry. Come on, let's practice!
Besides, we're all just humoring your selfishness here, you know？ And you give us that attitude...？
Hold on... What do you mean, selfish？ I just wanted everyone to...
To have more fun, and stop letting people walk all over you, and actually speak your minds. That's why—
Still... do we really seem that pitiful...？
Are you still thinking about what happened at our last practice？
I bet Nagakura and Sasaki saw right through me the whole time. Thinking I'm no different from those girls.
Sorry, it's nothing. Let's drop the heavy talk.
Um... well... I think our timing was a little off...
All right, let's take it from that part one more time...
(No good, we're completely out of sync...)
...What is this... What's wrong with us...
Uh... All right, let's give it another shot!
I knew this was never going to work...
(Can we really pull off a live show like this...？)
(Guess Sasaki and Nagakura already went home...)
Mm... When I look at the two of them... at Sasaki and Nagakura...
Somehow, it feels like I'm looking at the old me... from before I met you.
The old you... You think so？
Not that we're alike or anything... Just the way they shut themselves up in their own world and try not to get involved with anyone around them...
I had you, so... I was able to change, though.
Still, seeing them like that gets to me a little, you know.
The kindness you gave me... I wondered if I could share it with someone else...
I thought maybe the me I am now... could do something like that for someone...
That's why I came up with the whole band idea. Even if it was on the spur of the moment.
But in the end... that was just me being selfish, wasn't it...
...I'm going to apologize properly to the two of them.
Besides... after talking so big, it'd be pretty pathetic if the show flopped because of me.
Yeah, we've gotta make this show a success!
Exactly! You'd better stay sharp too!
(All right, back to band duty today!)
(The mood in here is as heavy as ever...)
Being late to practice... Being selfish about switching parts, writing the song, and everything.
And... for dragging you into this out of nowhere, saying we should start a band.
I thought I was doing a good thing.
Those girls were making fun of you, and I figured it had to bother you. That I'd do something about it for you.
That I'd do it for you... That's what I was thinking.
...Nobody asked you to butt in... Acting all high and mighty...
You were butting in, sure, but it still made us really happy. Me and Nagakura both...
We felt like as long as you were with us, Kobayakawa, we could do our best... That we could finally hold our heads a little higher...
That's why... I really want this show to be a success. I don't want everything we've worked so hard on together to go to waste.
No more making excuses and running away... I want to give it everything I've got, for real...
